en.headline: Election Committee nomination period ends with 1,155 forms received
en.dek: Returning officers received 1,115 candidate nomination forms and 40 from designated bodies by the 5pm close on Tuesday, with 31 of 36 elected subsectors set for contests on 22 November.
body: The two-week nomination period for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections closed at 5pm on Tuesday. Returning officers had received a total of 1,115 nomination forms from candidates and 40 forms from designated bodies since the period opened on 7 October.

Of the 36 subsectors that elect some or all of their members, 31 have more nominees than seats and will hold polls on 22 November. The social welfare subsector is among the most competitive, with 25 people contesting 15 elected seats, while the medical and health services subsector has 23 nominees for 15 seats.

The Election Committee comprises 1,500 members in total. The 982 elected seats will be filled by the November poll; they will sit alongside 362 ex-officio members and 156 members nominated by designated bodies. The new committee will elect the next Chief Executive in March 2027 and also nominate and elect 40 members of the Legislative Council.

zh.headline: 選舉委員會提名期結束 共接獲十一百五十五份表格
zh.dek: 提名期周二下午五時結束，選舉主任累計接獲一千一百一十五份候選人提名表格及四十份指定團體提名，三十一個界別分組將於十一月二十二日進行選舉。
body: 二○二六年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉提名期周二下午五時結束。自十月七日開始以來，各界別分組選舉主任累計接獲一千一百一十五份候選人提名表格，以及四十份指定團體提名表格。
三十六個需透過選舉產生全部或部分委員的分組之中，有三十一個候選人數超過席位，將於十一月二十二日進行投票。社會福利界十五個選舉席位有二十五人競選，醫學及衛生服務界亦有二十三人争十五席。
選委會由一千五百名委員組成，其中九百八十二席由選舉產生，另有三百六十二名當然委員及一百五十六名由指定團體提名。新一屆選委會將於二○二七年三月選出下一任行政長官，並負責提名及選出四十名立法會議員。
